description: Total Water Level and Coastal Change Forecast Viewer is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS National Assessment of Coastal Change Hazards project; NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration; National Weather Service. Total water level (TWL) at the shoreline is the combination of tides, surge, and wave runup. For individual stations, the viewer shows animated estimates of the elevation where the ocean will meet the coast for the next 6.5 days. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Landslides. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
